messages:
marta: Quick review request — marketplace hero tile + QuickStart bundle for NimbusCloud. Need partner+Redwood logo lockup, a 1-line summary for the listing, CTA copy for the QuickStart, and final hero/thumbnail files. Attaching initial comps: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw-nimbus/marketplace-drafts

jon: Specs we should follow? sizes + format?

marta: TL;DR specs below for designers (also in the Drive):
```
hero: 1200x627 PNG sRGB, 72dpi, <2MB
thumbnail: 800x800 PNG (transparent bg allowed), <500KB
logo lockup: SVG + PNG @2x (provide vector + flattened)
screenshots: 1280x720 JPG 80%
alt text: <= 80 chars preferred
metadata: short blurb (1 sentence), long blurb (2-3 lines), quickstart CTA (12-18 chars)
```

lee: Flag — partner has strict brand rules. Need to confirm logo clearspace and no-crop restrictions before we publish. @natalie can you ping them for written approval? :eyes:

natalie: Pinged Nimbus marketing; they returned SVGs + brand-guidelines.pdf. They explicitly require min clearspace = 16px and "no color overrides" on their logomark. Also they want to review the marketplace quote before go-live. Link: https://shared.nimbus/brand-guidelines.pdf

jason: I'll update the comps to match clearspace and export new thumbnails by EOD. Quick question — do we upload separate thumbnails for the bundle (bundle thumbnail) vs listing thumbnail?

marta: Yes — we want a bundle thumbnail (800x800) and a listing tile (1200x627). Also include: hero, two screenshots, quickstart PDF, short README snippet, and partner case study blurb (1-2 sentences).

brand-ops-bot: Asset checklist created: /assets/marketplace/1718001234/ (hero, thumbnail, logo-lockup, screenshots, quickstart-pdf, case-blurb). Status: hero=draft, thumbnail=pending, logo-lockup=received, screenshots=pending, quickstart-pdf=pending, case-blurb=pending

lee: Legal note — Nimbus asked for trademark attribution when using "NimbusCloud" (use ™ on first mention). Also they require quote approval for the case blurb. Keep me copied when you send the draft to them.

natalie: They just suggested alt text: "Redwood + NimbusCloud accelerate LLM inference across hybrid infra." That's 74 chars. They said it's fine to shorten further if needed.

marta: Great — I'll use that alt text and update the one-line blurb to: "Redwood + NimbusCloud accelerate LLM inference across hybrid infra." I'll upload updated assets to the Drive and tag for partner sign-off when done. :thumbsup:

jon: Thanks — once Nimbus OKs, can we schedule the marketplace publish window? I'd like to avoid the Wednesday release cutoff.

marta: Prefer Thu morning publish. I'll coordinate with eng-ops for the publish window after sign-off.
